entities.summary: Edward Allison "Cally" McCalmon was a Canadian professional ice hockey right winger who played two seasons in the National Hockey League for the Chicago Black Hawks and Philadelphia Quakers. He played 23 games in the 1927–28 season with Chicago, and 16 games in 1930–31 with Philadelphia. The rest of his career, which lasted from 1920 to 1931, was spent in various minor leagues. McCalmon was born in Varney, Ontario, but grew up in Lumsden, Saskatchewan.
